plugin.name: The Suffering Widescreen Fix
CutsceneBorders.description: Off removes the black bars of cutscenes; Letterbox keeps the original bars. Applies immediately.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies as the game updates its view.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Resets this page to its defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.FOVFactor.help: Changes the camera width. 1.0 keeps the original framing.
menu.CutsceneBorders.help: Off removes cutscene bars. Letterbox keeps the original bars.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. The game is made for 60; higher frame rates can upset its physics and timing. Restart required.
